name: Hexblood
summary: Folk bound to hags by magic or bargain, who carry witch-craft in their blood and can watch through tokens of themselves.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: See in Dim Light within 60 feet as if it were Bright Light, and in Darkness as if it were Dim Light.
traits.text: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Eerie Token
traits.summary: Bonus Action, once per Long Rest: make a token of yourself; send it 25-word telepathic messages or see and hear through it from up to 10 miles.
traits.text: Bonus Action, once per Long Rest: you shed a lock of hair, a nail or the like and make it a token, which lasts until your next Long Rest unless destroyed. Within 10 miles of it you can: send a telepathic message of up to 25 words to whoever holds or carries it (a Magic action); or, as a Magic action, look and listen from the token's spot for 1 minute (ending early if you're Incapacitated or choose to), after which the token harmlessly falls apart.

traits.name: Hex Magic
traits.summary: Disguise Self and Hex always prepared; each free once per Long Rest (Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma).
traits.text: You always have Disguise Self and Hex prepared. You can cast each once without a spell slot, regaining that use on a Long Rest, and you can also cast them with any spell slots you have. Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for them (choose when you pick this species).
